usage.source_scope: Eight entities absent from the PB1/PB2-A/PB3 formal cohorts, split four Development and four test, with one source-audited identity-bearing and one context query per entity.
usage.project_application: Supply conditional positive named-place authority before a functional portal may bind to the requested entity.
usage.modifications: Replace whole-alias-only matching with distinctive English/Han/public-mark carriers, fixed traditional/simplified folding, split-local metadata IDF, cross-carrier conflict veto, and an asymmetric proof/appearance join. Missing text remains UNKNOWN.
usage.expected_effect: Recover partially corrupted bilingual identity evidence without wrong-entity proofs, preserve target-present fallback, and sharply reduce appearance-driven wrong-place confirmation.

evaluation.setup: Source-only pixel audit froze 24 Commons images before any PB4 model call. Development alone selected the CLIP appearance arm and per-text-arm score/margin thresholds. RapidOCR used frozen PP-OCRv6 models; appearance selected measured-faster verified RTX 5060 CUDA.
evaluation.effect: On eight fresh test queries, SCIL emitted 6/6 correct proofs with zero wrong proofs, including all 4/4 identity-bearing views. English canonical matching emitted 0 proofs and flat bilingual alias matching emitted 1 correct context proof. The asymmetric join raised positive acceptance from 2/8 to 6/8 and reduced the source-label-negative proxy from 1/24 to 0/24.
evaluation.claim_boundary: Fresh conditional bilingual-signage identity evidence on a curated opportunity stratum. Wrong-request rows are source-label proxies, not exhaustive physical absence. No open-world identity, portal ownership, active-view, navigation, arrival, product, user, or safety claim follows.

evidence.summary: Frozen source, algorithm, controls, Development-only selection, six-clause gate, and successor.

history.change: Executed PB4 once and promoted SCIL as a conditional proof-positive identity authority after all six frozen gates passed.
